```{r}
#| label: "Libraries and setup"
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(colorspace)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(devtools)
#library(paindrawr)
load_all()

# USE THIS CODE in TERMINAL TO RENDER
# quarto preview /home/steen/projects/paindrawr/presentation/2026_10_29_OUH.qmd --no-browser --no-watch-inputs


theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))
theme_gtsummary_compact()

# Load background images
bg_palmar <- here("inst/extdata/lower_arm_palmar.png")
bg_mird <- here("inst/extdata/mird_body_background.png")
bg_zealand <- here("inst/extdata/zealand.png")
```


```{r}
#| label: "load data"
#| include: false
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: false

# Get the Data 
# Get standard data
base_data <- read_csv(here("presentation", "2026_09_15_data.csv")) 

# Keep only relevant columns
base_data <- base_data |>
  select(
    record_id = "Record ID", 
    tool = "Please choose one of the two items", 
    distance = "Please choose a distance" , 
    geography = "How well do you know the geography of east Denmark?" 
  )


json_files <- list.files(
  here("presentation/2026_09_15_drawings/"),
  pattern = "json$",
  recursive = TRUE
)

paindraw_data <- pdr_import_json(here(
    "presentation/2026_09_15_drawings/",
    json_files
  ))

## Id is nested in the drawing id string
paindraw_data <- paindraw_data |>
  mutate(
    record_id = str_extract(id, "R[0-9]+F") |>
      str_remove("^R") |>
      str_remove("F$") |>
      as.double()
  )

# Because we have multible drawings pr id we go wide before joining
### First extract image type
paindraw_data_wide <- paindraw_data |>
  mutate(
    view = str_extract(id, "F-.+-") |>
      str_remove("^F-") |>
      str_remove("-E.+$") |>
      str_remove("^background_image_")
  ) |>
  select(-id) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = view,
    values_from = pdr_data
  )

my_data <- base_data |>
  left_join(paindraw_data_wide)

```

# Imaginary hand pain

```{r}

```


## Single drawing


# Quantitative analysis of imaginary handpain

## What to quantify?

### Area and Intensity

```{r}
#| echo: false
my_data |> 
  slice_sample(n = 2) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(
    paindrawr_data = palmar, 
    background_image = bg_palmar
    )
```

## Workflow to get pr. drawing summary stats 

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
flowchart LR
  A["JSON file<br/>strokes, x/y points"]
  B["Tibble<br/>pdr list column"]
  C["Tibble<br/>pdr list column<br/>+ .rgba matrix"]
  D["Summary data<br/>area: pixels, proportion<br/>intensity: mean, min, max"]

  A -->|"pdr_import_json()"| B
  B -->|"pdr_add_rgba()"| C
  C -->|"pdr_summarize_rgba()"| D
```


## Add an rgba render {.smaller}
```{r}
my_data <- my_data |> 
  mutate(
    palmar = pdr_add_rgba(palmar)
  )

my_data
```

## Get summary statistics {.smaller}

```{r}

my_data <- my_data |> 
  pdr_summarize_rgba(pdr_list = palmar, summary_stat = c("area", "mean"))

my_data
```


## Summarize across groups

```{r}
my_data |> 
  group_by(tool, distance) |> 
  summarise(
    area_mean = mean(palmar_area, na.rm = TRUE), 
    area_sd  = sd(palmar_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    intensity_mean = mean(palmar_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 
    intensity_sd = sd(palmar_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```



## Examples

```{r}
#| echo: false
my_data |> 
  filter(palmar_area == max(palmar_area)) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(palmar, background_image = bg_palmar) +
  labs(title = "Largest area") +


my_data |> 
  filter(palmar_area == min(palmar_area)) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(palmar, background_image = bg_palmar) +
  labs(title = "Smallest area") +
  
my_data |> 
  filter(palmar_mean == max(palmar_mean)) |> 
  pdr_plot_drawing(palmar, background_image = bg_palmar) +
  labs(title = "Highest mean intensity")   & 
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```




## Simple boxplot of summary data

```{r}
my_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tool, y = palmar_area, fill = distance))+
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5)
```
